name: daemon-console
description: v14 composition: the v13 worker payload stays, and the core daemon plus a console front end are added, so an installation has a server (apps/daemon/bin.js) and a UI (console/index.html) instead of only a stdio worker.

console.note: apps/console is the product console and always wins over the packaging shell. As of v14 it holds the pages (index.html, app.js, styles.css, assets/) but no static server, so the packaging-owned serve.mjs is copied in beside them: it is a loopback-only static server for the files next to it plus a narrow proxy for /healthz, /readyz and /api/v1/*, which is exactly what the product pages need and nothing more. The builder fails closed if the staged console ends up with neither a server nor a declared fallback, because a console directory nobody can serve is not a UI.

rules.note: Built-in rule pack. The builder validates every file with the repository's own detection package before it is staged, so a malformed pack fails the build instead of shipping a daemon that refuses to start.

entryForwarders.note: A four-line forwarder so node <bundle>/apps/daemon/bin.js resolves the real package in app/node_modules and keeps its bare-specifier imports working. The staged package is not duplicated.
